ruleDefinitions.name: Cloudflared Tunnels Related DNS Requests
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects DNS requests to Cloudflared tunnels domains.
Attackers can abuse that feature to establish a reverse shell or persistence on a machine.
 Note: Unmapped fields: QueryName

sequences.query: (QueryName = RGX("\\\.v2\\\.argotunnel\\\.com$") OR QueryName = RGX("protocol\\-v2\\\.argotunnel\\\.com$") OR QueryName = RGX("trycloudflare\\\.com$") OR QueryName = RGX("update\\\.argotunnel\\\.com$"))
